name: Cancel attack
summary: Cancel current attacks, guidance and jamming for the specified unit while retaining reservations.
requirements: Requires own-unit information and a unit accepting player orders. Does not propagate to formation members.
execution_note: Ends current attacks, attack alignment, laser guidance and offensive jamming; launched weapons may lose guidance. All waypoint reservations remain, including sonobuoy drops. Autonomous engagement settings remain unchanged, so the game may initiate another attack.
